messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected in ap-south1 gateway — error_rate=37% over 5m, triggered paging
Olivia R: seeing it too on console, looks like gateway 502 + downstream timeouts
Jae (oncall): I’m on it, reassigning to infra and SRE. grabbing initial logs.
Marta (infra): oncall handoff acknowledged. pushing quick health check to edge pool.
Priya (sre): can you paste the mdm query? I want to confirm backend latency vs gateway errors
Olivia R: run on prometheus: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="ap-south1",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="ap-south1"}[5m])) * 100`
Priya (sre): running... result ~38% consistent. 502 and 504s up.
Jae (oncall): description in thread: partial regional outage in ap-south1, prep failover to ap-southeast-1. customers in APAC may see degraded responses.
Sam (customer-ops): flagged 3 enterprise customers reporting errors, opening incident comms. ETA for mitigation?
Marta (infra): checking gateway logs, we’re seeing connection resets to ml-worker pool nodes and a spike in connection queue length on edge-proxy-3a.
Olivia R: deploying temporary increased proxy pool to reduce queueing, command: `kubectl scale deployment edge-proxy --replicas=8 -n ap-south1`
DevDeployBot: Deploy triggered by Olivia R: scaling edge-proxy -> 8 replicas (rolling)
Marta (infra): scaled. giving it 45s to warm. cache hit rate dropped recently, maybe KV TTL eviction causing backend load.
Priya (sre): confirm: redis 99th p90 latency on ap-south1 spiked at 600ms. backend services are timing out waiting on KV.
Jae (oncall): plan: 1) divert a portion of new requests to ap-southeast-1 via routing shift 2) increase gateway timeouts to avoid immediate 502s 3) throttle heavy customers as temporary backpressure
Olivia R: initiating a 10% traffic steer to ap-southeast-1 via route policy: `redwood route update --region-weight ap-southeast-1=10 --region-weight ap-south1=90 --apply`
ConsoleBot: Route change applied: ap-southeast-1=10%, ap-south1=90% (propagating)
Sam (customer-ops): notifying impacted customers that we're performing cross-region mitigation; preparing status page blurb now.
Priya (sre): temporarily extend gateway proxy timeout from 10s -> 20s for ap-south1 to reduce 502s: `sed` patch applied to config map.
DevDeployBot: ConfigMap updated and restart initiated for ap-south1 gateway (rolling restart)
Marta (infra): also increasing redis read-replica count in ap-south1 to absorb read pressure. running `infra playbook redis-scale ap-south1 read-replica +2`
Olivia R: after scaling, 5xx% dropped to ~18% over 5m. still above baseline but improving.
Jae (oncall): good. continue traffic steering to 25% if sustained, but don't exceed capacity in ap-southeast-1.
Priya (sre): investigating root: correlation shows a config push 12:07 UTC to auth-service that caused sudden burst of KVs with long TTLs. possible cache stampede.
Marta (infra): rollback candidate: auth-service config reverted to previous; rolling restart.
DevDeployBot: Rollback executed by Marta (infra): auth-service config -> previous.
Olivia R: post-rollback progress: 5xx now 6% and Redis latencies back near baseline. gateway queue length normalizing.
Sam (customer-ops): customers updated: incident mitigation in progress, some errors persisted for ~15m, most recovered after routing and rollback.
Jae (oncall): summary for postmortem: cause — config change to auth-service triggered cache churn -> redis latency spike -> gateway 502/504s; mitigation — scale proxies, scale redis replicas, increase timeouts, rollback auth config, cross-region traffic steer; impact — partial errors in ap-south1 for ~20m affecting enterprise customers; next steps — add canary for config pushes, KV TTL guards, traffic-weight safeguards.
Priya (sre): adding timeline notes to incident board. assigning follow-ups to infra and dev teams.
Olivia R: marking incident as recovering. will keep the channel open for 30m for follow-up monitoring. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged as RECOVERING by Jae (oncall)
